name: Untitled Planescape Project
summary: A cancelled first-person PC role-playing game set in the Planescape multiverse, designed by David “Zeb” Cook at Interplay’s RPG division. It was one of three Planescape videogame projects in development in the late 1990s. The project was later folded into Stonekeep 2, and no public build, screenshot set, or design document is known to have survived under the Planescape name.
